corrections.reason: Both visually (shorter left leg on 4th-order ባ compared to adjacent 1st-order በ) and grammatically (causative 'when I fed [ባበላሁ] five thousand people', not 'when I ate'), the printed text is ባበላሁ.

corrections.reason: The printed glyph clearly shows 4th-order ባ (shorter left leg than the following በ) in ባበላሁ ('when I fed four thousand people').
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 16:11 and the printed glyph clearly show 6th-order ኅ in እምብኅኦሙ ('from the leaven of the Pharisees'), misread as ኑ.
The printed glyph in ፊልጶስያስ is 4th-order ያ, not 2nd-order ዩ.
